display_title: [Pallas TPU] Copy trivially windowed refs of emit_pipeline asynchronously

head_commit.message:
[Pallas TPU] Copy trivially windowed refs of emit_pipeline asynchronously

emit_pipeline now overlaps the copies of trivially windowed inputs with the
first block prefetches, and the copies of trivially windowed outputs with the
waits for the last output blocks, instead of copying them synchronously.

name: Bazel CUDA
display_title: [Pallas] Reject writes to unaliased non-Ref inputs in `mpmd_map`

head_commit.message:
[Pallas] Reject writes to unaliased non-Ref inputs in `mpmd_map`

`_mpmd_map_abstract_eval` and `_mpmd_map_discharge_rule` previously ignored
`WriteEffect` and `AccumEffect` on inputs that were neither `AbstractRef` nor
present in `input_output_aliases`, silently dropping aliasing on mutations to
immutable array inputs. Raise a `ValueError` in `_mpmd_map_abstract_eval`
(also enforced by `_mpmd_map_typecheck_rule`) when a kernel writes to or
accumulates into an unaliased non-`Ref` input.

PiperOrigin-RevId: 1006520289
